title: Issue
description: One publication unit (production/issues/<ISS_ID>/issue.yaml): scenes, page and panel counts, and status. A chapter or a webtoon episode is an issue.

id.description: Issue ID, e.g. ISS_001. Matches the directory name.

source_span.description: Part of the source this issue adapts.

page_count.description: Number of pages in the issue.

panel_count.description: Number of panels across all pages.

opens_from.description: Continuity state file of the previous issue, relative to the workspace root, or null.

notes.description: Free-form notes for people. Never read by scripts.
